rows.question: What was the revenue growth percentage for Brave Bison Group plc in 2022?
rows.answer: Brave Bison's revenue grew by **46%** in 2022, to £31.7 million (2021: £21.7 million) [brave-bison.pdf p.8]. rows.question: What method does Brave Bison Group plc use to determine the fair value of equity instruments granted in share-based payment transactions?

rows.question: Did Brave Bison Group plc report any mergers or acquisitions during the year?
rows.answer:
Yes. Brave Bison reported one acquisition during 2022: Best Response Media (BRM). The Year in Review says BRM "was acquired during the period and integrated into Brave Bison Commerce" [brave-bison.pdf p.6]. The company incurred acquisition costs of £0.1 million in 2022 (2021: £0.7 million) relating to acquiring Best Response Media [brave-bison.pdf p.8]. The same review describes this as the company's third acquisition since mid 2020 [brave-bison.pdf p.6].

The Greenlight acquisitions were completed in 2021, not during 2022. In 2022 the company performed a purchase price allocation for them and impaired the Greenlight trade brand [brave-bison.pdf p.8].
